cues.en: Excuse me, but there's been some sort of mistake.
cues.zh: 不好意思，这里肯定搞错了。

cues.en: Oh, well, we'll sort that out later.
cues.zh: 噢，没事，我们回头再处理。

cues.en: Oh, that's a good one, We'll sort it out later after you've been crucified.
cues.zh: 呵，真搞笑，“回头再处理”，等被钉死在十字架上之后吗？

cues.en: Typical bloody Romans, Now you can shut up. Or what? I'll have to give up being crucified in the afternoons.
cues.zh: 典型的该死罗马人，现在给我闭嘴。不然呢？我下午就不能被钉十字架了吗？

cues.en: But I don't want to be crucified.
cues.zh: 可我不想被钉上十字架啊。

cues.en: Oh, cheer up, Brian. You know what they say.
cues.zh: 哎，高兴点，Brian，你知道老话怎么说的。

cues.en: Some things in life are bad. They can really make you sad.
cues.zh: 人生难免不如意，有时真叫人叹气。

cues.en: Other things just make you swear and curse.
cues.zh: 总有些事让你又骂又咒。

cues.en: When you're chewing on life's whistle, don't rumble.
cues.zh: 生活给你苦头时，别抱怨。

cues.en: Give them a whistle.
And this will help things turn out for the best.
cues.zh: 这样事情就会往最好的方向发展。

cues.en: Mind.
Always
look on the bright
side of life.
See?
Always
look on the light side of life.
Burst your lips and whistle. Have the bee.
cues.zh: 鼓起嘴唇吹口哨。尽情欢乐吧。

cues.en: Fame.
Always look on the bright
side of life. Very good.
Always
look on the light side of life.
